reviews.title: beware no wifi or Bluetooth without windows 11
reviews.comment: I've always used asus great layouts and boards, but this one does not support windows 10. If thats a dealbreaker, Look elsewere.
reviews.author: Jeremy

reviews.title: Great board, no issues.
reviews.comment: Worked as advertised. Got it to replace a dead on arrival Gigabyte B-650M. Fired right up, zero issues.
reviews.author: Adam Walters

reviews.title: Really versatile and useful
reviews.comment: I really wanted another model, but it was out of stock. I went for this one against all odds, and it was a good decision. It's been very useful for the components I use: several USB ports, three fans, and three RGB ports (some fans allow you to chain them with just one RGB port). The Wi-Fi is the icing on the cake, being able to use it without any issues from the start. I didn't like that it didn't come with more screws. Some standoffs, but nothing more? That leaves a lot to be desired. But I know it depends on the computer Case, but it should still come with something. The manual is super useful and well explained.
reviews.author: Gregor Gonzalez

reviews.title: wifi poor performance , bios issues
reviews.comment: No way to tell when Bios startup sequence have issues  no indicator light or  audio bip etc .... I just had blank screen for a min almost..then some bios messages finally. But there will be occasion when I kept restarting and no display . Finally when I was able to reset it and put one component at a time it was working , for 3 days at most . Then it went blank again. returning it , will order a different board . While it was working I had trouble installing wifi driver , when I could resolve it speed was not best .... I am holding my iphone next to the pc I am getting 450 mbps , same speed test with my PC with this card at exact same location 100 mbps .  Overall disappointed .
reviews.author: B. Chowdhury
